policies.notes: Malta / generic-.com tier per research/17-jurisdiction-policy-matrix.md (MGA Directive 2 of 2018 v3). Autoplay allowed with interval alert; bonus buy and enhanced presentation modes allowed; MGA minimum RTP 0.85 satisfied by the rtp-96 profile. Reality check content is MGA-mandated; 60-minute default until player-set. slamStop stays off as a design stance (illusion-of-control research). Engineering flags only, never legal conclusions.

UK/UKGC tier per research/17: RTS 14E bans quick/turbo/slam-stop/base-game skip; autoplay banned (RTS 8/8A); bonus buy treated as banned (RTS 3A+14A); 2500 ms minimum round with release-and-re-press; LDW celebration banned (RTS 14F); net position + session clock mandatory (RTS 2E/13C); reality check is player-set (null here, operator-supplied). maxStakeMinor 500 = GBP 5.00 default (25+); RGS MUST override per session for the 18-24 GBP 2.00 tier.

Germany/GGL (GlueStV 2021) tier per research/17: para 22a bans autoplay and fast presentation; the statutory 'average 5 s' spin ships as a fixed 5000 ms floor; stake cap EUR 1.00 default (maxStakeMinor 100) with RGS session overrides for 21+/qualified tiers; bonus buy impossible in effect and disabled; fixed 60-min reality check with post-ack lockout handled by the platform. No jackpots on DE builds (this game has none).
